request.question: What does L1 add on top of the SAP data products?

answer:
**L1 (Silver) adds conformed dimensions, mining business terminology, unified currency, and clear provenance flags on top of the raw SAP BDC data products.**

The SAP_BDC_L1 views transform the zero-copy L0 adapter layer by applying the ontology (MAP_ tables and DIM_ views) to translate SAP technical terms into mining-domain language, standardizing all amounts into USD, exposing real SAP keys, and tagging every measure with a PROVENANCE field (SAP, SAP_STANDIN, OPS, or MIXED) so analysts know which numbers are real and which are simulated.

| Layer | Objects | Rows | What it does | Provenance |
|-------|---------|------|--------------|------------|
| **L0** (SAP_BDC_L0) | 80 views | 33.2 M | Zero-copy adapter over SAP BDC; select and rename only | SAP |
| **ONTOLOGY** | 11 tables + 8 views | 6,025 | MAP_ and DIM_ tables translating SAP codes to mining terms | MIXED |
| **L1** (SAP_BDC_L1) | 12 views | — | Conformed views with real keys, mining names, USD, provenance flags | MIXED (SAP + SAP_STANDIN) |

For example, **L1_COST_POSTING** joins real SAP journal lines with stand-in operating cost, flagging C1 cost-base items (blueprint D20); **L1_MAINTENANCE_ORDER** enriches real orders with asset and site names and flags stand-in actual cost; **L1_PURCHASE_ORDER_ITEM** recovers the masked supplier by matching invoices.

**Next step:** Review the MAP_ and DIM_ ontology tables to ensure the SAP-to-mining translations match your site's chart of accounts and cost-element structure.

---

**Sources (simulated data):**  
*MIXED*: definitions (L1, ONTOLOGY), L1_COST_POSTING, L1_SALES, L1_MAINTENANCE_ORDER, L1_MAINTENANCE_NOTIFICATION, L1_SUPPLIER_QUALITY, L1_MATERIAL_STOCK, L1_MEASUREMENT, layers (ONTOLOGY tables/views, L1 views)  
*SAP*: L1_SUPPLIER_INVOICE, L1_PROJECT, L1_WORKFORCE_AVAILABILITY, L1_PURCHASE_ORDER_ITEM, layers (L0 views, ONTOLOGY tables)  
*SAP_STANDIN*: L1_BUDGET
